supplements.title: Design, synthesis, anticancer, antioxidant and computational evaluation of curcumin-benzodiazepine derivatives.
supplements.summary: Researchers created curcumin-benzodiazepine compounds that showed strong anticancer activity against breast cancer cells and antioxidant properties.

supplements.title: Cytotoxic isoflavones from the stem bark of Protea gaguedi.
supplements.summary: Isoflavones from Protea gaguedi plant show strong cytotoxic activity against cervical cancer cells, with potential drug development.

supplements.title: Exploring the chemical composition and anti-cancer potential of Matricaria recutita L. essential oil.
supplements.summary: Chamomile essential oil shows strong cancer-fighting potential against lung, liver, and breast cancer cells in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Green tea polyphenol-iron oxide chitosan nanoparticles modulate gut microbiota and regulate metabolic pathways.
supplements.summary: Green tea nanoparticles improved absorption and altered gut bacteria and liver metabolism in ways that may reduce inflammation and cancer risk.

supplements.title: Modulation of Oxidative Stress, Inflammatory Cytokines, and Mucosal Immunity by Green Synthesized Zinc Nanoparticles in Giardia Infection in Mice.
supplements.summary: Green-synthesized zinc nanoparticles show promise as an alternative treatment for giardia infections, potentially reducing side effects compared to standard drugs.

supplements.title: Reducing exposure to non-persistent endocrine-disrupting chemicals and their impact on human health: Evidence from dietary, behavioral, and residential interventions.
supplements.summary: Reducing exposure to hormone-disrupting chemicals through diet, consumer products, and home changes may improve reproductive, metabolic, and thyroid health.

supplements.title: Novel insights into skyrin action in cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Skyrin kills cancer cells by triggering stress-induced cell death through CHOP, acts as an antioxidant, and is pumped out by BCRP resistance protein.

supplements.title: Pyranobutflavin: a butoxy-bridged pyranone-flavonoid hybrid from baicalin, and its anti-hepatocellular carcinoma activity.
supplements.summary: Pyranobutflavin, a modified compound from baicalin, effectively kills hepatocellular carcinoma cells while sparing normal cells through multiple cancer-fighting mechanisms.

supplements.title: Associations of coffee, alcohol, medication and supplement use with the metabolome and lipidome: an observational study of premenopausal women.
supplements.summary: The study examined how coffee, alcohol, medications, and supplements affect metabolic and fat profiles in premenopausal women.

supplements.title: A natural coumarin, benjaminin, suppresses proliferation and migration and induces apoptosis in MCF-7 breast cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Benjaminin, a natural compound, stops breast cancer cell growth and kills cancer cells while leaving normal cells unharmed.

supplements.title: Epigenetic Reactivation of SOCS-3 and Inhibition of ERK1/2 Underlie Thymoquinone-Induced Apoptosis in a Chronic Myeloid Leukemia Xenograft Model.
supplements.summary: Thymoquinone reactivates a suppressed gene and blocks a growth pathway to trigger cell death in chronic myeloid leukemia.

supplements.title: Exploring the renoprotective potential of Beta vulgaris in diabetic nephropathy: an integrated network pharmacology, molecular docking and dynamics simulation study.
supplements.summary: Beetroot compounds show promise in protecting kidneys from diabetes-related damage through multiple cellular pathways, according to computational analysis.

supplements.title: Gut microbiome-mediated bioactive ingredients and health benefits of medicinal and edible fermented products: A comprehensive review.
supplements.summary: Fermented foods like yogurt and kimchi reduce colorectal cancer risk and improve metabolic health through beneficial gut bacteria and bioactive compounds.

supplements.title: Integrated in vitro and in silico characterization of Dittrichia viscosa methanolic extract: phytochemical profiling, antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anticancer activities.
supplements.summary: Mediterranean plant extract shows promise against cancer cells through its natural bioactive compounds and antioxidant properties.

supplements.title: 2-Butanone 4-glucopyranoside 6'-O-gallate isolated from Memecylon scutellatum exhibits anti-inflammatory activity via modulation of the NF-κB and MAPK signaling pathways in LPS-stimulated RAW 264.7 macrophages.
supplements.summary: A compound from Memecylon scutellatum plant reduces inflammation by blocking two key cellular signaling pathways involved in cancer and chronic disease.

off_label.title: A Combination of the Tryptophan Hydroxylase Inhibitor Telotristat with the mTOR Inhibitor Everolimus as an Effective Strategy Against Neuroendocrine Tumors.
off_label.summary: Combining two drugs—telotristat and everolimus—effectively fights neuroendocrine tumors better than either treatment alone.

off_label.title: A Phase 2 Multi-Center, Prospective, Randomized, Double-Blind Study to Assess the Clinical and Antiviral Efficacy and Safety of Nitazoxanide for the Treatment of Norovirus in Hematopoietic Stem Cell and Solid Organ Transplant Recipients.
off_label.summary: Nitazoxanide was safe but did not effectively treat norovirus in transplant patients, failing to reduce symptom duration or viral shedding.

off_label.title: Trifluoperazine induces ferroptosis in acute myeloid leukemia by suppressing the Nrf2/SLC7A11/GPX4 axis.
off_label.summary: Trifluoperazine, an existing antipsychotic drug, kills acute myeloid leukemia cells by triggering iron-dependent cell death and works better combined with venetoclax.

off_label.title: GPX8+ cancer-associated fibroblast-derived lactate contributes to lenvatinib resistance by facilitating BRPF1 expression through histone H3 lysine 18 lactylation in hepatocellular carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Certain fibroblasts produce lactate that helps hepatocellular carcinoma resist lenvatinib treatment; blocking lactate transport or a protein called BRPF1 can restore drug sensitivity.

off_label.title: Mitochondria-targeted metformin analogs activate the ER stress-unfolded protein response pathway to drive apoptosis in pancreatic cancer.
off_label.summary: A modified metformin drug targeting pancreatic cancer cell mitochondria triggers cell death by activating stress response pathways.

off_label.title: Repurposing melatonin for its potential roles in gastrointestinal cancers: highlighting the molecular mechanisms.
off_label.summary: Melatonin could boost gastrointestinal cancer treatment effectiveness while reducing chemotherapy toxicity through multiple anti-tumor mechanisms.

off_label.title: Beyond glycemic control: differential effects of empagliflozin and sitagliptin on insulin sensitivity and a shared increase in adropin in type 2 diabetes.
off_label.summary: Both empagliflozin and sitagliptin increase a beneficial protein called adropin in type 2 diabetes patients, though with different metabolic effects.

off_label.title: Repurposing monepantel in oncology: A conceptual mini-review of proposed mechanisms.
off_label.summary: Monepantel, an antiparasitic drug, shows promise against cancer by blocking cell growth pathways and triggering stress responses in tumor cells.

off_label.title: [Establishment of pediatric neuroblastoma cell line and its resistance mechanism to lorlatinib].
off_label.summary: Researchers found that neuroblastoma cells resistant to lorlatinib activate EGFR as an escape mechanism, and combining EGFR and ALK inhibitors effectively overcomes this resistance.

off_label.title: Noncanonical PI(4,5)P2 coordinates lysosome positioning through cholesterol trafficking.
off_label.summary: Blocking PI5P4K enzymes disrupts cholesterol transport in p53-deficient cancers, stopping tumor growth through mTOR pathway inhibition.

off_label.title: NAT10-Mediated ac4C Modification of circANKRD12 Reprograms the Tumor Microenvironment.
off_label.summary: NAT10 modification of circANKRD12 promotes multiple myeloma growth and immune suppression; desloratadine reverses both effects.

off_label.title: Repurposing Syrosingopine for Cancer Therapy: Lactate Trapping and ISR Sensitization as Metabolic Vulnerabilities.
off_label.summary: Syrosingopine, a repurposed blood pressure drug, blocks lactate transporters in cancer cells, forcing toxic lactate buildup and potentially slowing tumor growth.

off_label.title: Ablation of the adhesion G protein-coupled receptor ADGRL1 activates anti-tumor immune response via cDC1-T cell hub formation.
off_label.summary: Removing ADGRL1 protein activates immune cells to fight tumors and works better when combined with immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Synthesis and preliminary enzymatic evaluation of polyol-based 4-phenylbutyrate derivatives.
off_label.summary: Researchers created new drug derivatives combining 4-phenylbutyrate with polyols to potentially treat cancer by targeting cellular stress and energy metabolism.

off_label.title: Phase Ib Study of Imatinib to Increase RUNX1 Activity in Participants With Germline RUNX1 Deficiency
off_label.summary: Researchers test imatinib to boost RUNX1 activity in people with RUNX1 gene mutations who have increased blood cancer risk.

biomarkers.title: Design and Pictet-Spengler enabled synthesis of carboxamide-substituted imidazo[1,2-a]quinoxalines as dual EGFR and tubulin targeting anticancer agents.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers designed new compounds targeting breast cancer cells by simultaneously blocking EGFR and tubulin, with two compounds outperforming the drug erlotinib.

biomarkers.title: Biomolecular and cellular chirality: Novel diagnostic perspectives for diseases.
biomarkers.summary: Abnormal molecular chirality, particularly excessive D-amino acids and left-handed DNA, may serve as early biomarkers for cancer and other diseases.

biomarkers.title: Design, synthesis, and in-vitro evaluation of 2-(heteroarylthio)acetamido-1H-benzo[d]imidazole derivatives as PTP1B inhibitors for the treatment of type 2 diabetes.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers designed new compounds that inhibit PTP1B enzyme, with compound PD22-10 showing the strongest activity and potential for treating type 2 diabetes by improving insulin sensitivity.

biomarkers.title: Design, synthesis, anticancer, antioxidant and computational evaluation of curcumin-benzodiazepine derivatives.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers created curcumin-benzodiazepine compounds that showed strong anticancer activity against breast cancer cells and antioxidant properties.

biomarkers.title: Quantifying neuron-specific enolase on TiO2-goldurchin-modified electrodes for lung cancer diagnosis.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a biosensor using modified electrodes that can detect a lung cancer marker (NSE) at very low levels for improved diagnosis.

biomarkers.title: Bioinformatic and experimental analysis reveals ITGA5 as a driver of ovarian clear cell carcinoma progression and platinum resistance.
biomarkers.summary: ITGA5 protein drives ovarian clear cell carcinoma growth and resistance to platinum chemotherapy through a specific cellular signaling pathway.

biomarkers.title: Lung Cancer Yield by Baseline Screening Lung CT Screening Reporting and Data System (Lung-RADS) Assignment and Patient Factors: The Population-Based Research to Optimize the Screening Process Lung Consortium.
biomarkers.summary: Lung cancer screening effectiveness varies between clinical trials and real-world community settings.

biomarkers.title: Early adjunct anti-PD-L1 immunotherapy improves outcomes and restores infection-induced immune paralysis in mice with invasive pulmonary mucormycosis.
biomarkers.summary: Early anti-PD-L1 immunotherapy combined with antifungal treatment improves survival in mice with invasive pulmonary mucormycosis by reversing infection-induced immune failure.

biomarkers.title: Advances in the diagnosis and classification of B-ALL: comparative insights from updated guidelines.
biomarkers.summary: Updated genetic classification methods reduce unclassifiable B-ALL cases and better predict survival, enabling more precise treatment selection.

biomarkers.title: Early steroid and anakinra use to manage axicabtagene ciloleucel toxicity reduces the total duration of CRS and ICANS.
biomarkers.summary: Early steroids and anakinra reduce symptom duration in lymphoma patients receiving CAR-T cell therapy without compromising treatment effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: Low flow cytometry events in detecting CNS involvement in pediatric B-cell precursor ALL: NGS validation and prognostic significance.
biomarkers.summary: Lowering flow cytometry detection thresholds to 3 events improves identification of CNS involvement in pediatric ALL, predicting higher relapse risk.

biomarkers.title: T-cell receptor beta constant 1 flow cytometry for diagnosing clonality in mature T-cell neoplasms: a systematic review and meta-analysis of diagnostic accuracy.
biomarkers.summary: TRBC1 flow cytometry accurately and efficiently detects clonal T-cell patterns to diagnose mature T-cell cancers.

biomarkers.title: Utility of flow cytometric PAX5 protein detection for the diagnosis of B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
biomarkers.summary: Flow cytometry rapidly detects PAX5 protein to diagnose B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia more efficiently than traditional methods.

biomarkers.title: Cytotoxic isoflavones from the stem bark of Protea gaguedi.
biomarkers.summary: Isoflavones from Protea gaguedi plant show strong cytotoxic activity against cervical cancer cells, with potential drug development.

biomarkers.title: Exploring the chemical composition and anti-cancer potential of Matricaria recutita L. essential oil.
biomarkers.summary: Chamomile essential oil shows strong cancer-fighting potential against lung, liver, and breast cancer cells in laboratory tests.

trials.summary: Lung cancer screening effectiveness varies between clinical trials and real-world community settings.

trials.summary: Early anti-PD-L1 immunotherapy combined with antifungal treatment improves survival in mice with invasive pulmonary mucormycosis by reversing infection-induced immune failure.

trials.summary: Updated genetic classification methods reduce unclassifiable B-ALL cases and better predict survival, enabling more precise treatment selection.

trials.summary: Early steroids and anakinra reduce symptom duration in lymphoma patients receiving CAR-T cell therapy without compromising treatment effectiveness.

trials.title: Safety, efficacy, and patient-reported outcomes 6 years after fidanacogene elaparvovec in adults with hemophilia B.
trials.summary: A single-dose gene therapy for hemophilia B maintained effectiveness and safety over six years, eliminating bleeding in most patients.

trials.title: Low flow cytometry events in detecting CNS involvement in pediatric B-cell precursor ALL: NGS validation and prognostic significance.
trials.summary: Lowering flow cytometry detection thresholds to 3 events improves identification of CNS involvement in pediatric ALL, predicting higher relapse risk.

trials.title: A revised classification of FVIII concentrates: rationale and novel metrics.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a new hemophilia A treatment with four times longer-lasting activity than standard options, requiring only weekly dosing.

trials.title: Long-term outcomes of 40 Gy CCRT with weekly cisplatin and systemic chemotherapy in limited-stage ENKTL.
trials.summary: Lower-dose radiation therapy (40 Gy) with chemotherapy achieved strong long-term survival and local control in limited-stage NK/T-cell lymphoma.

trials.title: Utility of flow cytometric PAX5 protein detection for the diagnosis of B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
trials.summary: Flow cytometry rapidly detects PAX5 protein to diagnose B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia more efficiently than traditional methods.

trials.title: Clinical experience with a rare brainstem tumor: ganglioglioma. Illustrative case.
trials.summary: Surgeons successfully treated a rare brainstem tumor called ganglioglioma, only the fifth case ever reported in medical literature.

trials.title: Interdural spinal cyst following lumbar puncture: illustrative case.
trials.summary: A rare spinal cyst developed in a patient's lower back after a lumbar puncture procedure.

trials.title: Presacral meningocele presenting after rupture into the retroperitoneal space with acute debilitating intracranial hypotension: illustrative case.
trials.summary: A rare spinal fluid sac ruptured, causing severe pressure changes in the brain; surgical repair eliminated the problem.

trials.title: The Landscape of Clinical Trials for TCR-T Cell Therapy.
trials.summary: TCR-T cell therapy, which targets tumor-specific antigens, shows promise across solid and blood cancers, with most trials in early phases focusing on lung and head/neck cancers.

trials.title: Pseudoprogression in Koos grade 4 vestibular schwannomas following stereotactic radiosurgery: temporal dynamics and radiological predictors.
trials.summary: Vestibular schwannoma tumors may appear to grow after radiation treatment due to swelling, not actual progression.

trials.title: The impact of complementary interventions on pain and disability in patients with chronic non-cancer pain: A network meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Network analysis finds complementary therapies effective for reducing chronic non-cancer pain and disability compared to standard pharmaceutical treatments.
